## Summary
- What does this PR change and why?

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feature/*` — New functionality or enhancement
- [ ] `bugfix/*` — Fix for an existing issue

## Verification
- [ ] `npm run check:all` passes locally with zero errors and zero undocumented warnings
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests added or updated

## Warning & Error Justification Checklist
- [ ] No new warnings or errors were suppressed
- [ ] *(If any suppression was unavoidable)* Every suppression includes an inline `Justification: <reason>` comment and any repo-wide or non-trivial entry is logged in `docs/engineering/warning-justifications.md`
